messages:
marco: heads up — noticed a couple of problems in the tool-calling migration doc while prepping a customer walkthrough.
liz: which ones?
marco: 1) the example schema uses type: ["object", "array"] for `results` which makes our parser treat it inconsistently across SDKs. 2) the JS snippet references `examples/call.js` but the path is now `sdk/js/tool_call.js`.
sam: oof, that array/object union is classic flake. can you paste the problematic fragment?
marco: sure:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "results": { "type": ["object", "array"] }
  }
}
```
kelsey: recommend switching to oneOf with explicit shapes so the generated validators are stable:
```json
"results": {
  "oneOf": [
    { "type": "object", "required": ["id"] },
    { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["id"] } }
  ]
}
```
marco: yup that's what i had in mind. also we should add a short note in the guide about how SDKs map `null` -> None/undefined and how clients should guard for both.
liz: i'll update the migration doc and add a little example showing the validator behavior in python and js (2-line snippets).
sam: can you also add a tiny unit in docs-ci that loads the example file and runs jsonschema.validate against the schema? catches this class of regression.
marco: yes please. i can pair with you on the CI job config.
docs-bot: CI: linkchecker failed in /docs/migration/tool-calling.md: broken link to /sdk/js/call.js (see https://ci.internal/links/512).
kelsey: i'll fix the anchor and add a redirect note in the docs for old paths.
liz: i'll open a small PR with: schema switch to oneOf, JS+PY inline snippets, path fix, guardrail sentence about explicit enums/required fields, and a docs-ci test. will tag reviewers.
marco: please include the exact jsonschema fragment from above in the commit and add a comment in the docs explaining why union types are discouraged for top-level arrays/objects.
sam: when you open the PR drop it here — i'll run the docs-ci job locally before merging.
docs-bot: PR opened by liz: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 (oneOf migration, snippets, path redirects, docs-ci test).
liz: PR opened. thanks all — aiming to merge today so product can re-run integration checks tomorrow.
marco: thanks, looks good. i'll follow up if any customer regressions show up.
sam: will validate the new examples against the runtime parser after merge.
kelsey: added a 1-line note under "guardrails" about preferring explicit oneOf/enum combos for action-like outputs.
docs-bot: CI: linkchecker now passes for branch liz/migrate-toolcall-512. docs-ci job queued.
liz: keeping this thread for the final merge + green CI status.
